map.SMS 二维码。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: SMS QR Code. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.短信二维码本质是把 URI Scheme 编码进二维码：扫码端解析出 URI 后: An SMS QR code encodes a URI scheme: the scanner parses the URI and hands it to the system, which opens the message composer with the number and body prefilled. iOS supports sms:number?body=…, while some Android also supports the older SMSTO:number:content format. Longer content makes the code denser (higher version, smaller modules); keep the body under 100 characters, use error-correction level M, and leave a quiet zone of at least 4 modules when printing. Special characters in the body and number must be percent-encoded first.
map.在门店物料上放「扫码发短信」：预填号码与内容，用户扫码后只需点击发送即可参与活动: Place a "scan to send SMS" on in-store materials: prefill the number and content so users only tap send to join a campaign.
map.唤起短信草稿，需用户确认发送。: It opens a message draft; the user confirms sending.
map.为什么扫出来内容被截断了？: Why is the scanned content truncated?
map.因为二维码容量有限，内容越长模块越密、越难扫；另外短信 URI 中的特殊字符需做: QR capacity is limited—the longer the content, the denser and harder to scan; also, special characters in the SMS URI must be percent-encoded, as unencoded & and # are treated as parameter separators and truncate the content. Keep the body under 100 characters, encode special characters first, and use a more lenient error-correction level with a sufficiently large print size.
